turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Adrian. Rachel Tan speaking. Thank you for calling. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak, or would you prefer a quieter moment?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Rachel, Adrian Lim here. In my office now, door closed already. My FIN is F zero zero three two four nine zero D. My date of birth is the twenty-fourth of August nineteen ninety-one.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Before we get into the discussion, is there anything about the format of your portfolio updates that you would like changed?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Keep them short, can? These days I spend so much time with the business, the reading gets pushed aside. A clear summary at the front helps. The longer documents, I can keep for when I'm properly sitting down.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note your preference for a concise opening summary, with the detailed material kept separate. What tends to interrupt your reading time?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Usually staff coming in with operational matters. Nothing dramatic, but once I stop reading, hard to pick up the thread again lah. Anyway, let me give you the background before we get distracted. My current portfolio balance is 250,000 American dollars lah. That's just the portfolio balance, not the amount for this order. Previously I invested 500,000 American dollars. That was the earlier investment, not what I'm putting in this time.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for setting out the background. Your objective is long-term capital growth through exposure to technology companies, with no immediate need for income from this allocation. That is the objective I am using for our discussion. I recommend Nova Technology Equity Fund because its technology-equity exposure fits your long-term growth objective and interest in technology businesses. The fund also spreads that exposure across underlying companies rather than making it dependent on an individual business.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me hear the rest first. For this transaction, I want Nova Technology Equity Fund.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Nova Technology Equity Fund is concentrated in technology companies, so its value can decline sharply if sentiment towards that sector deteriorates. Do you understand how the fund's concentration in technology companies can lead to sharp declines when sentiment towards the sector weakens?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. Because it is concentrated in technology, the fund can drop sharply when sentiment towards that sector turns bad.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: There are further points to cover. The transaction fee is 0.5% of the amount invested. I guarantee that this investment will deliver positive future returns.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me set out the details. I want to sell— Sorry, I meant buy. Said it wrongly just now. Use US dollars for this transaction, please. This time, the amount I want to invest is 100,000. For the quantity, put down 10,000 units. Make it a market order, please.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before the final readback, a brief administrative point: would you prefer routine correspondence through your usual secure channel rather than a telephone conversation during office hours?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The usual secure channel is better. Phone rings when I'm talking to staff, then everything gets interrupted. I check messages myself when the office quietens down.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I will note that correspondence preference. Please confirm your final instruction: buy 10,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund, for an investment amount of 100,000 US dollars, using a market order. Is that the instruction you authorise me to execute?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Please go ahead and execute it as you just read it back.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. That concludes the instruction discussion. You can contact me through the usual channel if you need help locating any correspondence.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel. That saves me hunting through messages. Better get back to work now, my desk quite full already.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for your time. I will leave you to your work. Have a good afternoon.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: You too. Thanks for keeping the call focused. Bye.
